burn: post-v87 NEAR/day measured from epoch_issuance.json (epochs starting >= v87_first_epoch_start)
cap_share: mean realised share of the 2.5% cap over in-window epochs, from epoch_issuance.json

hsp029.formula: cap(t) = start_cap - (start_cap - target_cap) * min(t, ramp_months) / ramp_months, t = months since activation (365.25/12 days), per epoch (modelled daily)
hsp029.source: HSP-029 'Technical Specification' (gov.near.org HoS thread, post 1: 'Activation occurs one full quarter after ratification'); ratification = end of vote.dao proposal 29 timelock, read at block 223,248,541 (deep-dive sec C11)
